notes: Literal conjecture k < a(n-1) fails at n = 1 (k = 3 > 1) and n = 2 (k = 2 = a(1)): literal_false_n1, literal_false_n2 with step1, step2 (A072532.lean). Corrected claim (n >= 3) is open: it says the least prime = -1 mod q above q - 1 is below q^2 - 1 for q = a(n-1), implied by the q^2 conjecture for least primes in progressions, not reached by Linnik/Xylouris or GRH bounds; holds for n <= 160 (script, BPSW). Outside Lean: none. The n <= 160 check is script-only.
